_comment: The manifest of @abap2ui5/node - abap2UI5 transpiled to JavaScript, for a
Node host. It lives HERE and NOT at node/package.json: a package.json inside
node/ makes that directory an npm package root, and `npm run <script>` from
there stops walking up to this repository's own scripts. `cd node && npm run
express` then answers `Missing script: express`, which is exactly what
node/playwright.config.js starts its web server with - so all four browser
projects failed to boot (#2772, found by CI).
node/setup/pack-npm.mjs copies this file to package.json in a STAGING
directory outside the checkout, sets the version, assembles the trees
beside it and packs there. The version below is deliberately a placeholder:
the package's version is the framework's, and `npm run check:version` holds
that in package.json and z2ui5_if_app=>version - not here.
name: @abap2ui5/node
description: abap2UI5 for Node: the framework transpiled to JavaScript by @abaplint/transpiler over open-abap, with an HTTP handler, an express server, the UI5 frontend and the ABAP sources to transpile your own apps against - from one release commit.
